svg.text: A predicted chimera is not an experimental structure
Protein architecture can be source-grounded while the three-dimensional fold remains uncertain.
SOURCE structures/manifest.json; PDB 6N9N; Venezia et al., Nature (2026), doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10982-x Fig. 3a / Methods
METHOD / LIMIT Gsdmd:Tmem106a model is low confidence. Experimental parent GSDMD coordinates do not validate the chimera fold.
Blue residues 1–73: Gsdmd-derived. Red residues 74–118: novel out-of-frame C terminus.
